title: The Knight in the Panther's Skin
summary: Shota Rustaveli composed this Georgian narrative poem towards the end of the twelfth century, on Queen Tamar's order and under her patronage. Set in imagined kingdoms of Arabia, India and China, it came to be regarded as Georgia's national epic. Its oldest surviving manuscript dates only to 1646.

uncertainty.note: Sources say "towards the end of the twelfth century" and "twelfth century"; years 1175-1199 are an interpretation of that phrase, not stated by the sources.
